notes.title: Patch note 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]Patch note 1.01[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed player "sticking" to walls and objects
[*] Fixed the appearance of the cursor when starting the game
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons passed through objects
[*] Fixed door colliders
[*] Fixed table colliders
[*] Fixed zombie colliders
[*] Fixed a bug where the gate animation could play twice
[*] Fixed a bug where post-processing effects might not be displayed
[*] Fixed a bug where zombies could pass through objects
[*] Fixed a bug where levels could be generated incorrectly
[*] Fixed a bug where the model of a fluorescent lamp was displayed incorrectly
[*] Added brightness setting
[*] Changed starting location
[*] Added ammo pickup sound
[*] Added sound when interacting with a closed door
[*] Added hint for interaction
[*] Revolver damage increased from 70 to 120
[*] Zombie damage increased from 15 to 17
[/list]
